messages.author: 147a9a8a92ff12c4
messages.subject: Questions Regarding Cross-lagged Analysis
parts:
Hi all,

I am doing a latent growth curve model with two variables (V1 and V2) each measured at four separate timepoints.

I would like to examine if there’re any cross-lagged relationships between them (I don’t have a hypothesis on which predicting which, so it may be either direction or both).

I’ve tried to find online literature on how to perform cross-lagged analysis using lavaan but I don’t quite understand the rationale. (I read this paper: Mackinnon, S. P., Curtis, R., & O'Connor, R. (2020, July 22). A Tutorial in Longitudinal Measurement Invariance and Cross-lagged Panel Models Using Lavaan.)

So, I tried to do the syntax as below. And I am not sure if it is correct. May I have some advice on the syntax, and if you have any literatures suggestions regarding the cross-lagged analysis, please let me know! Thank you so much!

#LGM cross-lagged_model
Cross-lagged_model <- "

#intercepts and growths for variable 1 (VarA) and variable 2 (VarB)
intVarA =~ 1*VarA_1 + 1*VarA_2 + 1*VarA_3 + 1*VarA_4
growthVarA =~ 0*VarA_1 + (-1)*VarA_2 + start(-2)*VarA_3 + start(-3)*VarA_4
intVarB =~ 1*VarB_1 + 1*VarB_2 + 1*VarB_3 + 1*VarB_4
growthVarB =~ 0*VarB_1 + (-1)*VarB_2 + start(-2)*VarB_3 + start(-3)*VarB_4

#variances and covariances of the intercepts and growths for VarA and VarB
intVarA ~~ intVarA
growthVarA ~~ growthVarA
intVarA ~~ growthVarA
intVarB ~~ intVarB
growthVarB ~~ growthVarB
intVarB ~~ growthVarB

#error variances for measurements of VarA and VarB
VarA_1 ~~ VarA_1
VarA_2 ~~ VarA_2
VarA_3 ~~ VarA_3
VarA_4 ~~ VarA_4
VarB_1 ~~ VarB_1
VarB_2 ~~ VarB_2
VarB_3 ~~ VarB_3
VarB_4 ~~ VarB_4

#cross-lagged analysis
#cross-lagged(1): correlation between VarA and VarB at the same timepoint
VarA_1 ~~ VarB_1
VarA_2 ~~ VarB_2
VarA_3 ~~ VarB_3
VarA_4 ~~ VarB_4
#cross-lagged(2): VarB at timepoint 2 as predicted by VarA and VarB at timepoint 1, vice versa
VarA_2 ~ VarA_1 + VarB_1
VarA_3 ~ VarA_2 + VarB_2
VarA_4 ~ VarA_3 + VarB_3
VarB_2 ~ VarB_1 + VarA_1
VarB_3 ~ VarB_2 + VarA_2
VarB_4 ~ VarB_3 + VarA_3

#means/intercepts
VarA_1 + VarA_2 + VarA_3 + VarA_4 ~ 0*1
VarB_1 + VarB_2 + VarB_3 + VarB_4 ~ 0*1
intVarA ~ 1
intVarB ~ 1
growthVarA ~ 1
growthVarB ~ 1
"

#test cross-lagged_model
Cross-lagged_fit <- lavaan(cross-lagged_model, data=eGPSdata)
summary(cross-lagged_fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

Best,
Leo

parts:
Hi Leo,

I am new to this, so please take whatever I say with a grain of salt…

However, I think what you may be talking about is an Autoregressive Latent Trajectory Model with Structured Residuals… The below article covers a number of models and provides syntax via online supplementary info. I have also attached some syntax examples from Ellen Hamaker which were from one of her articles, but I cannot remember which one or where I found it, so just attached to this message.

Cheers,
Atanas

Mund, M., & Nestler, S. (2019). Beyond the Cross-Lagged Panel Model: Next-generation statistical tools for analyzing interdependencies across the life course. Advances in Life Course Research, 41, 100249. https://doi.org/10/ggdp45
